start.welcome:
Hi! 👋 Glad to see you at Pingly!
Here you can meet new people, communicate and find interesting people from all over the world.
First, let's choose the interface language.

message.main_menu:
Are you ready to meet someone new?
Find a random person to talk to, choose your interests, or customize the search for yourself.
message.search_process:
We are looking for an interlocutor 🔎
 We are choosing an interlocutor for you. It may take a little time — we'll get to know each other soon!

 To cancel the search, click the button below or send the command /stop.
message.found:
The interlocutor has been found! 👋

 You can start communicating — the first message is yours :)
If you want to find another person to talk to, click 'Next' or send /next.To end the dialogue, click 'Finish' or send /stop.
